label: Make an API Call
description: Call any NxtSend REST API v1 endpoint (relative path under /api/integrations/make/v1). Required for Make review — must use a relative path. The endpoint is chosen at scenario time, so this module has no fixed operation.
notes: SKELETON — part of the Make custom-app spec (see integrations/make/app.json). Build this module in Make's web UI / VS Code from this spec; the endpoint (method + path) is the contract the module must call.
